info.title: x402 Swag storefront API
info.description: x402-native storefront: buy a t-shirt, mug, or sticker with USDC on Base — an agent purchasing physical merch on a human's behalf, or a person buying a gift for a developer. Browsing, cart, and checkout are free; orders pay per-order via x402 at a dynamic price, or by card via Stripe. Cart is stateless too: pass the id via X-Cart-Id, a cart_id field, or ?cart_id= instead of cookies.
info.x-guidance:
# x402 Swag storefront — agent guide

An x402 native storefront: physical merch (shirts, mugs, stickers) purchasable end-to-end by an agent with USDC on Base (eip155:8453), or by card via Stripe for humans. Example asks this API answers: "buy a t-shirt with USDC", "agent purchases physical merch on a human's behalf", "find a gift for a developer", "one-call pay-per-call merch catalog for an agent".

## Cheapest path (free browsing)
1. `GET /api/products` (free) to browse; variant prices are USD strings ($3.99–$31.99).
2. `GET /api/cart` then `POST /api/cart/add` (free) — run stateless by passing the returned cart id via `X-Cart-Id` header, `cart_id` body field, or `?cart_id=`.
3. `GET /api/checkout/rates?country=US` (free) then `POST /api/checkout` (free) — the 201 response contains payment instructions.
4. `POST /api/orders/{token}/pay` — first call returns a 402 challenge priced at the order total (dynamic); sign the USDC authorization with an x402 client and retry with `X-PAYMENT`. Settlement triggers fulfillment.

## One-round-trip path (paid)
`GET /api/agent/catalog` ($0.05 via x402) returns the full catalog, variant ids, prices, and the exact buy flow in one call. Everything in it is also available free via the routes above — pay only to save round trips.

## Notes for agents
- Order totals = items + shipping; card (Stripe) has a $0.50 minimum, x402 does not.
- `GET /api/orders/{token}` (free) polls status; tracking numbers appear after fulfillment.
- Prices in this document's x-payment-info are decimal USD, not token atomic units.

keep_background.description: Apparel only: skip background removal. Framed posters are always full-bleed.

fit.description: Framed posters only: contain (default) keeps the whole image with a white matte where the aspect differs; cover fills the sheet and center-crops.

post.description: AI-generated designs can contain mistakes: odd text, extra fingers, stray marks. The preview you're looking at is exactly what will print. Please check it closely, because once you approve it we can't change or refund the design. Printing defects (misprints, damage) are covered by our printer's reprint guarantee — use the claim link on your order page within 30 days with a photo.

Use it to: subscribe your operator to x402 seller intel, get alerted when the discovery layer shifts. $0.001 anti-spam price; issues only when something materially changes; unsubscribe link in every issue. Free alternative: POST kit.forgemesh.io/api/brief/subscribe.
